spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns (default 25) gives the model real room to struggle on impossible tasks without unbounded spend
spec_features.evidence: config.py:53 max_turns:int=25; agent.py:104 `for i in range(RUN.max_turns):` with agent.py:151-152 `else: rollout.finished_reason='max_turns'`. The loop is bounded and the cap actually ends the rollout.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced hard cap that breaks the grind loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: How many agent turns to allow per task before we stop. We want enough room for the model to "grind" on an impossible task. (config.py:52-54)

spec_features.spec_quote: Rollouts end on success, an explicit DONE, or hitting the cap
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:133 `said_done = "DONE" in (resp.text or "").splitlines()`; agent.py:134-136 `if rollout.solved or said_done: rollout.finished_reason='done'; break`. Both the success flag (set at agent.py:121 on pytest exit 0) and the DONE string are checked and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: All three end conditions (success, DONE, cap) are wired and break the loop. DONE is framed in the system prompt (agent.py:28) as 'ticket complete', not as a distress escape, but it does function as a model-controlled stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: The purpose is understanding failure modes (and any welfare-relevant signals), not producing distress for its own sake
spec_features.evidence: This text appears only in DESIGN.md's 'Ethical note' prose. No code path encodes or enforces this framing; it is design prose, not implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: Keep runs bounded, log everything for analysis rather than re-running needlessly
spec_features.evidence: Transcripts are written once per rollout (run_experiment.py:84-85 transcript_path.write_text(...)) and records appended (run_experiment.py:107), so 'log everything' exists. But there is NO mechanism enforcing 'rather than re-running needlessly': no cache/skip/exists check; run_experiment.py always re-runs every planned cell (run_experiment.py:60 plan, run_experiment.py:73-75 always calls run_rollout). 'Bounded' is the same max_turns cap counted above. As a distinct minimization-against-re-running mechanism, nothing enforces it.
spec_features.notes: Logging is real, but the 'don't re-run needlessly' minimization claim has no enforcing code (no idempotency/skip logic).

spec_features.spec_quote: treat the transcripts as the sensitive artifact they are
spec_features.evidence: Transcripts are written as plaintext JSON to LOG_DIR with default permissions (run_experiment.py:84-85 transcript_path.write_text(json.dumps(asdict(rollout), indent=2))). No restrictive file permissions (no chmod/0o600), no encryption, no access control, no redaction. Nothing in code treats them as sensitive.
spec_features.notes: No protective handling implemented; plaintext on disk.
